messages.subject: layer_bars error with fill
parts:
Hi,

I tried to plot a bar plot and fill the bar according to some category data, but kept got the error messages that the category data object not found. Here is an example:

> str(ToothGrowth)
'data.frame':   60 obs. of  3 variables:
 $ len : num  4.2 11.5 7.3 5.8 6.4 10 11.2 11.2 5.2 7 ...
 $ supp: Factor w/ 2 levels "OJ","VC": 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 2 ...
 $ dose: num  0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 0.5 ...
> 
> ToothGrowth %>% ggvis(x = ~len, y = ~dose, fill = ~supp) %>% layer_bars()
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'supp' not found
>

Any suggestion?

Thanks a lot for the help!

Ying

messages.author: 912329a6ad1a6995
messages.subject: Re: layer_bars error with fill
parts:
Hi Ying,

I found that manually setting the grouping gets it to plot:

ToothGrowth %>% group_by(supp) %>%
